display.title: Shabbos Mevarchim Adar I: A Month of Joy in a Leap Year
display.summary_short: Shabbos Parshas Mishpatim blesses the coming month of Adar I. Why a leap year has two Adars, and why Adar is a month of joy.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that this Shabbos, Parshas Mishpatim, is also Shabbos Mevarchim, when Hashem gives a big blessing for the whole coming month. The month is called Adar I, the first Adar, because this is a leap year with two months of Adar, Adar I and Adar II. Everyone should be in shul to receive the blessing. He also tells children to get ready for the new Tzivos Hashem Simcha Club, because as soon as Adar begins it is a mitzvah to be very happy.
display.lesson: When Adar begins, we increase in joy.
